ev.q: Forty-nine cases were identified in 25 states, including 14 (29%) in children aged <5 years.
Among 36 interviewed patients (or their parents or guardians), 30 (83%) reported hedgehog contact before becoming ill.
Eleven (26%) of 42 patients with available information were hospitalized, and no deaths were reported.
